test_details.hc5: alpha = min(h/hbar, max(4, 0.7 h_max/hbar)); omega = e^2/(1-h)^(alpha/2)

generation_order: Z = rng.standard_normal((n, p)) @ cholesky(Sigma).T  (identical to Phase A's X draw)
leverage cells only: X1, X3 = (exp(s*Z) - exp(s^2/2)) / sqrt((exp(s^2)-1) exp(s^2)); others X = Z
error draw exactly as Phase A (gaussian / heteroskedastic on X1, X2 / skewed / heavy_tailed)

criteria.C3: C1 rule on robustness and leverage cells at every N
criteria.C4: BH FDR <= q + z99*SE, q in {.05, .20}
